verdict.rationale: Skyfire supplies verified agent identity (KYA tokens), and its docs say the merchant's site, or a bot manager in front of it, can use that identity to let an agent through. The allow/deny decision is made by the merchant's own site or third-party bot manager, not by a Skyfire merchant control, so it is a building block rather than the capability. Per-service identity requirements gate buyers only by verification level, and the pack documents no Skyfire control to rate-limit, allowlist, or denylist specific agents or agent platforms.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can rate-limit, allow, or deny specific agents and agent platforms accessing my catalog and checkout
